Lee · Listen & Shadow 14

Food — what you eat, and a place you know
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
ON THE WAY TO LUNCH
👤 Partner
So, what should we eat?
자, 우리 뭐 먹을까요?
💬 Lee
I could eat kalguksu every day.
저는 칼국수는 매일도 먹을 수 있어요.
could eat ~ every day — ~는 매일도 먹을 수 있다
같은 패턴으로 — "I could eat pasta every day." · "I could watch this show every day."
💬 Lee
But I can't do really greasy food.
근데 너무 기름진 건 못 먹어요.
can't do ~ — ~는 못 한다/못 먹는다 (구어)
같은 패턴으로 — "I can't do horror movies." · "I can't do early mornings."
💬 Lee
I'm trying to cut back on coffee these days.
요즘 커피를 줄이는 중이에요.
cut back on ~ — ~를 줄이다
같은 패턴으로 — "I'm trying to cut back on sugar." · "I'm trying to cut back on late nights."
💬 Lee
I usually go for something spicy.
저는 보통 매운 걸로 가요.
go for ~ — ~를 고르다/시키다
같은 패턴으로 — "I usually go for the window seat." · "I usually go for black."
💬 Lee
It depends on my mood.
그날 기분에 따라 달라요.
it depends on ~ — ~에 따라 다르다
같은 패턴으로 — "It depends on who I'm with." · "It depends on the season."
A PLACE I KNOW
👤 Partner
Anywhere good around here?
이 근처에 괜찮은 데 있어요?
💬 Lee
There's a place near my office that does great noodles.
사무실 근처에 국수 잘하는 데가 있어요.
a place that does ~ — ~를 (잘) 하는 가게
같은 패턴으로 — "There's a cafe near my house that opens early."
💬 Lee
They're known for their pork belly.
거기 삼겹살로 유명해요.
be known for ~ — ~로 유명하다
같은 패턴으로 — "He's known for being on time." · "The area is known for its night view."
💬 Lee
It's nothing fancy, but the food is solid.
화려한 덴 아닌데, 음식은 확실해요.
nothing fancy — 화려하진 않은 · solid — 탄탄한, 믿을 만한
같은 패턴으로 — "It's nothing fancy, but it works."
💬 Lee
You have to try their kimchi stew.
거기 김치찌개는 꼭 드셔봐야 해요.
you have to try ~ — ~는 꼭 해봐야/먹어봐야 한다
같은 패턴으로 — "You have to see this video." · "You have to hear this song."
💬 Lee
Next time you're in Seoul, I'll take you somewhere even better.
다음에 서울 오시면, 더 좋은 데로 모실게요.
next time you're in ~ — 다음에 ~에 오면
같은 패턴으로 — "Next time you're in town, call me." · "Next time you're in the office, stop by."
느리게 12/12 · 보통 12/12
